pricing.faq1q: What happens when I hit my AI credit cap?
pricing.faq1a: We’ll show a gentle nudge in-app. You can top up, upgrade, or wait for the next monthly reset.
pricing.faq2a: Yes. Paid plans are month-to-month unless you choose annual billing for a discount.
pricing.faq3a: Yes — full Arabic UI with proper mirroring and Noto Sans Arabic typography.
pricing.faq4a: PostgreSQL with row-level security per workspace. We never sell your data.
pricing.faq5q: Is PlayStore affiliated with Google or Google Play?
pricing.faq5a: No. PlayStore.xyz is an independent product. Google, Google Play, and related marks are trademarks of Google LLC. We are not endorsed by or affiliated with Google.

exportModal.title: Ready to Paste in Google Play Console
exportModal.intro: Blocks below match Play’s character caps. Follow the steps, then paste into Main store listing.
exportModal.step1: Open Google Play Console → your app → Grow → Store presence → Main store listing.
exportModal.step2: Copy each field with Copy, or use the green “Copy All for Play Console” button to copy App Name, Short Description, and Full Description in one step.
exportModal.step3: Paste into the matching fields in Play Console: App name, Short description, and Full description.
exportModal.step4: Check character counts in Play Console, tweak wording if needed, then save.
exportModal.tipOpenConsoleTab: Tip: Open Google Play Console in another tab for easy copy-paste.
exportModal.copyToast: Copied! Now paste in Google Play Console → {field}
exportModal.pasteHint: Preview blocks use Play length caps so pasted text fits store limits.
